question: Doul Utsav is majorly celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Doul Utsav is a major festival celebrated in **Assam**.
 
• It is also known as "**Holi of Assam**" and is celebrated with great enthusiasm and fervor.
 
• The festival marks the onset of spring and is associated with the worship of** Lord Krishna and Radha.**
 
• During Doul Utsav, people participate in various cultural activities, including traditional dances, songs, and processions.
